newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Automotive sector seen using more aluminium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Automotive sector seen using more aluminium.

text.p: The world automotive market for aluminium will increase by an average 4.5 percent a year through to the year 2003, AME Mineral Economics forecast on Thursday.

"While this is consistent with our own forecasts of primary automotive aluminium demand growth of 3.9 percent for the U.S. and 5.7 percent for Japan for the rest of the decade, most of the demand in this sector will be for extrusions and castings," AME analyst Michael Farrell told the Australian Metal Conference.
In the next four years, overall costs shouldered by aluminium smelters worldwide would decline by about four percent, due in part to lower power and alumina costs, Farrell said.
The replacement of some higher-costing production capacity with newer more efficient "super smelters" would also drive down costs, he added.
